snippet.title: Ultrapolis Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5314650/Ultrapolis/

Ultrapolis is a city diorama sandbox like Townscaper and Tiny Glade. Build your city without budget, management whether it's high tech or low life.
